meta.title: Music in the Park: Two Reviews
meta.textType: functional: two reviews of one event, blog posts

paragraphs: On Thursday, April twenty-ninth, Lily put two reviews of Music in the Park on the class blog. Mia sat at her desk at home and opened the page. Leo's review was on the left with four stars. Mia's review was on the right with three stars. Her notebook lay open beside the laptop. She read Leo's review first.

Posted by Leo. I give Music in the Park four stars. It was a perfect afternoon, because the sun was out and the grass was soft. Many families sat on mats near the stage. The jazz band played first, and I sat near the front with May. The band had drums, a bass, and a trumpet. The drums were very fast, so May clapped. May said, "Jazz is my favorite music, too." Next, the comedy man told jokes about his dog. I laughed so much that I dropped my ice cream. The classical group played last. The violins sounded nice, but the songs were quite slow, so I looked at the clouds. In my opinion, jazz is cool, and comedy is funny. Do you like jokes?

Under the two reviews, Nadia left a short comment. It said, "Which act did you like best?" Mia smiled, because she had an answer. A cup of tea stood beside her laptop. She took a sip, and then she read her own review once more.

Posted by Mia. I give Music in the Park three stars. My favorite act was the jazz band, because I love the sound of the trumpet. The players smiled at each other while they played. Lily and I missed the first song, because we helped a woman on the bus. The classical group was lovely, because the violins sounded soft and clear. The players looked very serious, but their music made me feel calm. A violin is a lovely instrument.

The comedy man was too loud, so I did not hear all his jokes. The park was full of people, so we sat far from the stage. Next time, we may sit closer to the front. I give only three stars, because I missed a song and the comedy man was too loud.
Mia typed her answer under Nadia's comment. "I liked the jazz band best, especially the trumpet player." A minute later, Leo wrote his answer, too. "Me too! The jazz band can have my next ice cream."
text.summary: Lily puts two reviews of Music in the Park on the blog. Leo gives four stars and Mia gives three, and each gives reasons. Nadia asks which act the friends liked best, and Mia and Leo both answer.
